categories_thin: Tutoring / test prep: still none independent with a New Brunswick street address. The only 08901 test-prep listing found is The Princeton Review at 390 George St, which is a national chain and therefore excluded; Rutgers learning centres are university-run.
Bookstores: no independent bookstore identified - only Rutgers/Barnes & Noble campus stores.
Music and art schools: no independent music or art school with a New Brunswick address; results were Octopus Music School (North Brunswick) and School of Rock (East Brunswick, a franchise).

Pet grooming / boarding: re-searched. The New Brunswick 08901 groomers returned either lack a street address (The Prestigious Paw) or are actually in Milltown (Ditzy Dog, 93 Clay St); the rest are chains or in Edison/North Brunswick.
Sign shops: only Garnet Graphic Solutions is independent with a New Brunswick address; AlphaGraphics (317 George St) and The UPS Store are franchises.
Hardware: one independent found on re-search (Home Garden Hardware, 570 Jersey Ave) - previously reported as a gap; still single-source.
Furniture: four independent stores after dropping the Livingston Ave addresses that fall in North Brunswick; none has a website.
Funeral homes and event venues are thin on purpose: only those with a confirmed New Brunswick address were kept.
caveats: Scope rule for faith-affiliated and nonprofit operators (applied uniformly, not case by case): a congregation- or nonprofit-run thrift shop, childcare centre or bike shop is IN scope because it runs a public storefront/service; a place of worship itself, or devotional activity, is OUT. This is why Second Reformed Thrift Shop, Mt. Zion CDC Preschool, the two Catholic Charities early learning centres, Gan Yeladeem and New Brunswick Bike Exchange are listed.

Scope rule for food: food MANUFACTURING, wholesale and distribution is in scope (De Stefano Foods, Home-Like Food Co., Mr Ice Bucket, Resnick Distributors are producers/distributors, not places to eat or order from a delivery app); food SERVICE - restaurants, cafes, bakeries, delis, pizzerias, caterers, grocers, butchers, liquor and convenience stores - is out and has been removed wherever found.

Cannabis dispensaries (Earth & Ivy, Puffin Store NJ) are licensed independent retail and are not on the exclusion list, so they are kept with corrected categories rather than dropped; a reviewer who wants dispensaries out of scope should remove those two rows.

Chain screen: branded hotels were removed (Hyatt Regency, 2 Albany St, deleted as a national brand). The Heldrich is kept as the zone's independent hospitality property. Motion Industries (22 Home News Row) is flagged because it is a branch of a national industrial distributor.
Chain-franchise or branded services encountered and excluded: AlphaGraphics, The UPS Store, The Princeton Review, FASTSIGNS, School of Rock, PetSmart and the big-box hardware chains.

Zone is New Brunswick city, group D only. The French Street & Joyce Kilmer directory also lists roughly a dozen group B salons, barbershops and nail studios (Azteca Salon, Barbershop Azareños, Carol's 2 Esthetic, B & B Beauty Salon, Nereyda's, Patty's, Mayra's, Yuri's, Nail City, Victor's Barber Shop) and one group C auto body shop (World Class Auto Body, 321 Handy St) that fall outside the assigned group and are therefore not included here.

Several addresses reached by New Brunswick-targeted searches actually sit over the North Brunswick line (Livingston Ave above the line, Georges Rd, Ryders Ln); these were removed. Choice Cleaners (608 Livingston Ave) was dropped on this basis - directories place it in North Brunswick 08902.

Google Maps result feeds are viewport-limited and return only a subset of places, so small French Street / Easton Avenue storefronts may still be missing. Yellow Pages, Cylex, BBB and Manta mostly block automated access; Overpass/OpenStreetMap was unreachable.
data_gaps: Natelson's Inc (10 Jules Lane, 'Clothing & Boutiques' in the NJ business directory) was deliberately NOT added: trade press reports the New Brunswick store moved to Stouts Lane in Monmouth Junction after about 30 years downtown, so the 10 Jules Ln row looks like a legacy listing. Source: https://princetoninfo.com/business/for-natelsons-going-out-of-business-is-good-business/

The French Street business directory publishes a phone number on each storefront page in a form that did not extract here. Eleven added French Street rows (Florería & Decoración Cristal, Botanica Santa Barbara, Chuchi's Furniture, D'Solution, Los Primos, Mi Gente, Mundo Latino, Mundo Travel, Costamar Travel, Delmy's Taxes, Liberty JCC) therefore carry phone Unknown - retrieve from the cited directory page.

Unverified rows retained from single, partial listings: PrimeFix (732-314-7046 unconfirmed), Southeastern Plastics (no phone), Saplings Academy (could not be reconfirmed as operating), Home Garden Hardware (one directory only), Vertigo Vaporium (directory only), Express Mart & Smoke Shop (City Center only).

Phone numbers for Knights Phone Repairs and Puffin Store NJ come from map/City Center listings, not from the businesses' own pages; New Brunswick Mini Mall's number was corrected but still rests on one directory - all three should be confirmed at outreach.
No street address for Phoenix Chemical in the NJ business directory - marked Unknown.
Headcount not verified for large sites (Ranbaxy, Cerro Flow, Cambridge-Lee, Resnick, Motion Industries) against the 500-employee exclusion.
No confirmed independent bookstore, music/art school, tutoring centre or toy/comic shop inside New Brunswick city limits; no independent pet groomer with a verifiable New Brunswick street address.

State licensing lists (childcare, contractors, cosmetology, cannabis) were not systematically harvested; licensed-but-unlisted businesses may exist. NJ Cannabis Regulatory Commission licence PDFs were seen in search results but not opened individually.
